head_commit.message:
STA-2373 wrap oversized hero heading words at mobile widths

The 145px overflow at 390px on the native-forms-v2 module routes comes
from hero fixture titles whose uppercase h1-clamp headings contain
unbreakable words (INSURANCESIMPLESTEPS measures ~519px of text against
a 374px box; the subpage hero shrink-0 aside additionally widens the box
to word width). Add [overflow-wrap:anywhere] to both hero headings so
oversized words wrap: unlike break-words it also lowers min-content, so
the shrink-0 aside can shrink to the container.

Verified against the built theme CSS at 390x844: subpage hero
132px -> 0px, homepage hero 0px maintained; ui-react hero suites 6/6.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
